versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Eight-phase ASCE/SEI 41-23 Tier 1 deficiency-based seismic evaluation workflow covering scope and Performance Objective intake, FEMA Common Building Type selection, seismicity look-up, Basic / Structural / Nonstructural / Foundation-Geologic checklist execution with C / NC / U / N/A disposition, deficiency aggregation, Tier 2 / Tier 3 gating, and a signed-PE memo output.
